summary.zh: 机器人开发爱好者，大三在读，目前于人形机器人公司实习。专注于 MCU 与 Linux 开发、运动控制、强化学习和机器人感知。
summary.en: Robot development enthusiast and junior-year student. Interning at a humanoid robot company, with a focus on MCU and Linux development, motion control, reinforcement learning, and robot perception.

title.zh: 开源 SliverWolf 桌面四足

description.zh: 发布具备语音控制与机械臂协同作业能力的桌面级串联四足机器人 SliverWolf。
description.en: Released SliverWolf, a desktop serial quadruped with voice control and robotic-arm collaboration.

description.zh: 基于 FreeRTOS 完成 R1 机器人嵌入式控制系统开发，实现 ±5 mm 定位精度、球体发射和夹爪夹取功能。
description.en:
Developed the FreeRTOS embedded control system for the R1 robot,
achieving ±5 mm positioning accuracy, ball launching, and gripper functions.

title.zh: 2024 福建省大学生电子设计大赛

description.zh: 基于 MSPM0G3507 开发自动驾驶小车系统并进入省级测试阶段。
description.en: Developed an MSPM0G3507-based autonomous vehicle system and qualified for provincial testing.

title.zh: 福建省大学生智能海洋装备设计制作大赛
title.en: Fujian Intelligent Marine Equipment Design Competition

description.zh: 负责浮力可控多自由度龙虾水下机器人的控制系统开发，获特等奖。
description.en: Led control-system development for a buoyancy-controlled multi-DOF lobster robot, winning the Special Prize.

description.zh: 代表福建理工大学参展并展示仿生波士顿大龙虾机器人，获新华社等媒体报道。
description.en: Represented Fujian University of Technology and exhibited the bionic Boston lobster robot, receiving national media coverage.

description.zh: 负责足式机器人全栈研发，在竞速、障碍和越野赛中获得三项国家二等奖。
description.en: Led full-stack development of the quadruped robot and earned three National Second Prizes.

title.zh: 2025 全国大学生电子设计大赛

description.zh: 负责自动测距系统功率计的硬件设计与制作，获全国二等奖。
description.en: Designed and fabricated the power-meter hardware for an automatic ranging system, winning the National Second Prize.

title.zh: 开源 BRS 并联四足机器人
title.en: Open Source BRS Parallel Quadruped Robot

description.zh: 在 GitHub 开源 BRS 并联四足机器人的机械结构与控制代码。
description.en: Open-sourced the mechanical structure and control code of the BRS parallel quadruped robot on GitHub.

description.zh: 负责 HTDW4438 仿生四足机器人的机械设计、控制算法开发与系统集成测试。
description.en:
Responsible for mechanical design, control-algorithm development,
and system-integration testing for the HTDW4438 bionic quadruped robot.
